d: Nature's greatest killing machine is three times as deadly when a mutated shark threatens a cruise ship.
A tectonic shift causes a series of ever-escalating earthquakes. Seismologists must stop the catastrophe.
The "Big One" will sink California into the ocean, and scientists must stop by triggering a volcanic eruption.
As the Civil War rages, President Lincoln undertakes a more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.
